name: University of Cambridge
typicalOffer: A*A*A, Mathematics and Further Mathematics (Further Maths A level only); IB Analysis and Approaches; Colleges usually require A* in Maths and/or Further Maths, sometimes A*/7 in Physics
notes: BA Mathematics (3 yrs) or MMath (4 yrs); STEP entrance paper required; DAMTP and DPMMS are world-leading research departments; Part III leads to distinction

name: University of Oxford
typicalOffer: A*A*A, A* in Mathematics and Further Mathematics (if available); if Further Maths unavailable: A*AAa with A* in Maths and a in AS Further Maths, or A*AA with A* in Maths
notes: 4-year MMath; Mathematics A-level at A* required; MAT entrance test; interview required; world-leading pure and applied mathematics departments
courseName: Mathematics / Mathematics and Statistics MMath or BA

name: Imperial College London
typicalOffer: A*A*A, A* in Mathematics; A* in Further Mathematics; A in another subject
notes: 3-year BSc or 4-year MSci Mathematics; Maths A* required; strong applied mathematics and mathematical physics; excellent links to tech and finance

name: University of Warwick
typicalOffer: A*A*A, A*A* in Mathematics and Further Mathematics, plus A in a third subject
notes: 3-year BSc or 4-year MMath; strong pure and applied maths; Warwick Mathematics Institute is research-intensive; excellent graduate employment record

name: Durham University
typicalOffer: A*A*A, including A*A* in Mathematics and Further Mathematics; alternatively A*AA (A*A in Maths and Further Maths, or A* Maths plus A in AS Further Maths) plus a suitable performance in an accepted mathematics test
notes: 3-year BSc or 4-year MMath; Durham Mathematics Department consistently top 10; strong algebra and geometry groups; collegiate experience

name: University of Edinburgh
typicalOffer: A*A*A*-A*AB, including Mathematics at A* (Further Mathematics preferred)
notes: 4-year MA (Hons) Mathematics; Scottish 4-year Honours structure; strong pure and applied maths; Maxwell Institute for Mathematical Sciences

name: University College London
typicalOffer: A*A*A, A*A* in Mathematics and Further Mathematics (or A*A in both plus a STEP/AEA result)
notes: 3-year BSc or 4-year MSci Mathematics; London location with excellent finance and tech employer links; strong in number theory and analysis

name: University of Bristol
typicalOffer: A*A*A, including A* in Mathematics and A in another mathematics-related subject (Biology, Chemistry, Computer Science, Economics, Physics), or A*AA including A*A in Mathematics and Further Mathematics
notes: 3-year BSc or 4-year MMath; strong in analysis, topology and applied mathematics; Bristol Quantum Information Institute for mathematical aspects

name: University of Southampton
typicalOffer: AAA, including Mathematics (grade A)
notes: 3-year BSc or 4-year MMath; strong operational research and statistics alongside pure maths; excellent links to Lloyd's insurance and actuarial sector

name: University of Manchester
typicalOffer: A*AA, including A* in Mathematics or Further Mathematics
notes: 3-year BSc or 4-year MMath; Alan Turing (founder of computing) studied here; strong applied mathematics and numerical analysis; Turing Institute links

name: King's College London
typicalOffer: A*AA, including A*A in Mathematics and Further Mathematics (in any order)
notes: 3-year BSc or 4-year MSci Mathematics; London location; strong in number theory, geometry and analysis; excellent finance and tech industry links

name: University of Leeds
typicalOffer: AAA-AAB, including a minimum of grade A in Mathematics
notes: 3-year BSc or 4-year MMath; strong analysis, algebra and applied maths; Leeds is a major centre for integrable systems and mathematical biology

name: University of St Andrews
typicalOffer: A*A*A, including A* in Mathematics
notes: 4-year BSc (Hons) Mathematics; Scottish 4-year Honours; strong pure mathematics and algebra research; small class sizes; excellent student satisfaction

name: University of Bath
typicalOffer: A*A*A, including A*A in Mathematics and Further Mathematics
notes: 3-year BSc or 4-year MMath; Bath's placement year option; strong applied mathematics and probability; excellent links to financial and actuarial employers

name: University of York
typicalOffer: AAA-AAB, AAA including A in Mathematics, or AAB including A in Mathematics and A in Further Mathematics (or AAB with A in Mathematics and A in Further Mathematics at AS level)
notes: 3-year BSc or 4-year MMath; strong pure and applied maths; York's mathematical logic group is world-leading; good graduate employment record

name: University of Nottingham
typicalOffer: A*AA-AAA, At least A level mathematics; the offer depends on whether applicants have A level or AS level further mathematics
notes: 3-year BSc or 4-year MMath; strong mathematical finance and statistics; Nottingham Centre for Industrial and Applied Mathematics; good industry links

name: University of Exeter
typicalOffer: AAA-AAB, including A-Level Maths grade A (Maths, Pure Maths or Further Maths accepted)
notes: 3-year BSc or 4-year MMath; strong applied mathematics; links to Met Office for mathematical modelling of climate; good graduate employment

name: University of Sheffield
typicalOffer: AAA, including Maths
notes: 3-year BSc or 4-year MMath; strong in probability and statistics; Sheffield Centre for Applied Mathematics; good links to Rolls-Royce and engineering sector

name: University of Birmingham
typicalOffer: AAA, including Mathematics or Further Mathematics (grade A)
notes: 3-year BSc or 4-year MMath; strong in algebra, analysis and mathematical physics; Birmingham's maths department has a strong research profile

name: Newcastle University
typicalOffer: AAB, including grade A in Mathematics (or ABB with A in Maths plus one A level from Further Maths, Biology, Chemistry, English Literature, Geography, History, Physics, Modern/Classical Languages, or grade 2 in any STEP paper)
notes: 3-year BSc or 4-year MMath; strong in statistics and data science; Newcastle Business School links for finance applications; good regional employer network

name: University of Glasgow
typicalOffer: AAB, A-level Mathematics at A
notes: 4-year BSc (Hons) or MA (Hons) Mathematics; Scottish 4-year Honours; strong algebra and analysis; Maxwell Institute links; excellent student support

name: University of Surrey
typicalOffer: AAB-ABB, Mathematics at Grade A
notes: 3-year BSc or 4-year MMath with optional professional training year; Surrey's placement programme is outstanding; strong applied maths and statistics

name: Cardiff University
typicalOffer: AAB-BBB, Must include grade B in Maths
notes: 3-year BSc or 4-year MMath; strong in mathematical analysis and geometry; Cardiff School of Mathematics has a strong research profile; Welsh medium option available

name: University of Liverpool
typicalOffer: ABB, including Mathematics A level grade A
notes: 3-year BSc or 4-year MMath; strong in mathematical physics and algebra; Liverpool was home to Oliver Lodge (early radio); good industry links

name: University of Leicester
typicalOffer: ABB, including Maths
notes: 3-year BSc or 4-year MMath; strong in pure mathematics and mathematical physics; Leicester has a good community feel with supportive staff
